note: Reviewed extension of the attachable statuses (0.30.2). research/status-effects-F5FEE03DCFDB.json stays the fact source: 'attachable' there means a mapped player-side attack already applies the status through a DamageInfo slot. This policy adds statuses an attack may carry: 'enemy_slot' ones the game itself applies through DamageInfo slots of enemy or hazard rows (the same mechanism, on other rows), 'other_system' ones the game applies by other means (areas, beams, abilities) whose definition is a real attack effect. Every addition needs allow_unverified_effect until a live test passes. Terrain, stim, weather and system statuses are never attachable.

tiers.enemy_slot: The game applies it through DamageInfo status slots on enemy or hazard rows; the slot mechanism is the same on a weapon row, but no weapon applies it in vanilla.
tiers.other_system: EXPERIMENTAL: the game never applies it through a DamageInfo slot; its definition is an attack effect (damage over time or a debuff), but whether a slot-applied instance behaves like the game's own is unknown.
